## Summary

Describe what changes and why.

## Area

- [ ] Unreal gameplay / C++ / Blueprints
- [ ] Art / audio / animation
- [ ] Pedagogical content / narrative
- [ ] Parent portal
- [ ] Backend / multiplayer / identity

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant automated checks pass
- [ ] No secrets or real child/user data included
- [ ] Performance impact considered for tablet targets
- [ ] Multiplayer authority/permissions reviewed if applicable
- [ ] Pedagogy review completed if learning content changed
- [ ] Cultural/sensitivity review completed if real-world culture content changed

## Evidence

Add screenshots, profiling data, tests, or reproduction notes as appropriate. Never attach production child/user PII.
